question: What topology and measurement-domain statuses occur across the complete one-edge grammar at a common two-event horizon?
rule_selection: all 220 R00 definitions, no candidate filtering
seed_selection: all seven exact R00 seeds in their registered order
rule_id: SHA256 of ASCII canonical JSON: {schema:mu-rule-v1,rhs:sorted arc list}; keys sorted, separators comma/colon, no spaces or newline
siblings: Replicate zero has oldest, newest and uniform children; other replicates have uniform only. All children inherit their parent's split. Deterministic duplicates are not added.
rng_seed: first eight SHA256 bytes of UTF-8 'rng|' plus parent key, interpreted unsigned big-endian; unused but retained for deterministic schedulers
partitions: unchanged R02 SHA256 parent-key modulo-ten rule; discovery may execute later, other partitions remain reserved/not_executed
execution_order: R00 rule enumeration: RHS length then lexicographic multiset; registered seed order; replicate ascending; registered scheduler order where applicable
observation: Reciprocal-pair density, induced motif histogram with complete/excluded coverage, exact degree-null status and distribution at each actually reached snapshot. Null-mean difference is descriptive only.
terminal_policy: Record actual terminal state and terminal event count; later requested snapshots are terminated_before_horizon, never padded or treated as resource censoring
undefined_policy: V<2 gives undefined primary density; degree-null degeneracy is uninformative; motif multiplicity exclusions remain visible; no cell is removed from accounting
inference: No p-values, bootstrap claims, candidate ranking, promotion or causal validation. Uniform frequencies are empirical over the declared seeds, not probabilities of general emergence.
budget_stop: Keep completed/failed/timeout rows and mark untouched suffix not_started; no selective retries or reduced snapshots. These runtime limits require implementation and a separately registered pilot before launch.
launch_requirements: registered throughput/storage pilot and explicit complete/partial budget accounting
registered launch protocol pins this design digest and kernel/measurement receipts
immutable per-attempt records and terminal/censoring tests
